channel.title: Oh, Mother Mine DIY
channel.description: Easy DIY home decor, furniture makeovers, kids' crafts and handmade gifts for busy moms.

item.title: Terracotta Pot Makeover: Easy Painted Planters on a Budget
item.description: Give plain pots a terracotta pot makeover with paint, texture and the right sealer. Step-by-step tips so your painted planters last indoors and out.

item.title: DIY Christmas Decorations the Whole Family Can Make
item.description: Make cozy DIY Christmas decorations on a budget: salt dough ornaments, dried orange garland, paper stars and more, with kid-friendly steps and safety tips.

item.title: DIY Fall Porch Decor Ideas for a Warm Welcome
item.description: Create cozy DIY fall porch decor with pumpkins, mums, crates, layered rugs, and lanterns. Budget-friendly ideas and safety tips for a welcoming autumn entry.

item.title: How to Make a DIY Farmhouse Wreath for Any Season
item.description: Make a DIY farmhouse wreath with a grapevine base, faux greenery, and a simple bow. This step-by-step tutorial is easy, budget-friendly, and works year-round.

item.title: DIY Organization Ideas for Busy Moms (That Actually Stick)
item.description: Simple DIY organization ideas for busy moms: a family command center, drawer dividers, entryway drop zone, pantry labels and kid-friendly toy storage.

item.title: How to Choose Paint Colors for Your Home Without the Stress
item.description: Learn how to choose paint colors with confidence: understand undertones, light, sheen, and the 60-30-10 rule, then test samples the right way before you buy.

item.title: Beginner Sewing Projects That Make Your Home More Organized
item.description: Start with these beginner sewing projects for the home: cloth napkins, envelope pillow covers, drawstring bags and fabric bins, with simple measurements.

item.title: Dollar Store DIY Decor Hacks That Don't Look Cheap
item.description: Try these dollar store DIY decor hacks to turn frames, glass vases, baskets, and candle holders into stylish home decor with paint, twine, and creativity.

item.title: Easy Kids Crafts for Rainy Days (Using What You Already Have)
item.description: Beat the indoor boredom with easy kids crafts for rainy days: playdough, paper plate animals, cardboard creations and more using supplies you already have.

item.title: Easy DIY Home Decor Ideas on a Budget (That Actually Look Good)
item.description: Refresh every room with easy DIY home decor ideas on a budget: thrifted makeovers, painted accents, plant styling, and simple swaps busy families can finish.

item.title: Easy Mason Jar Crafts for Gifts, Decor and Everyday Life
item.description: Try these easy mason jar crafts: painted vases, lanterns, gift-in-a-jar mixes and bathroom storage. Budget-friendly ideas with step-by-step instructions.

item.title: How to Distress Painted Furniture for a Timeworn Look
item.description: Learn how to distress painted furniture with sanding, wet distressing, wax resist, and layered colors, plus where to add wear so it looks naturally aged.

item.title: Heartfelt DIY Mother's Day Gifts Kids Can Actually Make
item.description: Easy DIY Mother's Day gifts kids can make: handprint art, sugar scrub, painted planters, coupon books and more. Budget-friendly ideas with simple steps.

item.title: Our Favorite DIY Chalk Paint Recipe (Three Ways)
item.description: Make chalk paint at home with our DIY chalk paint recipe using plaster of Paris, calcium carbonate, or baking soda, with exact ratios and smooth-finish tips.

item.title: How to Make Soy Candles at Home (Step-by-Step for Beginners)
item.description: Learn how to make soy candles at home with the right wax temperatures, fragrance load and wick tips. A simple beginner guide for gifts and cozy evenings.

item.title: How to Paint Furniture with Chalk Paint (Even If You've Never Tried)
item.description: Learn how to paint furniture with chalk paint step by step: cleaning, prep, brushing, waxing, and curing, plus beginner mistakes to avoid on your first piece.
